intent: Add a fail-closed cryptographic receipt spine to the already governed OMNIS WING R2.1 ordinary non-stream chat path: signed receipts, chained ledger verification, and an external-anchor fixture without introducing live credentials, Keychain mutation, or network.
audience: JourdanLabs Captain and independent gate deciding whether a real governed WING path can produce evidence that survives a local receipt mutation or ledger rewrite.
role: a security-minded Python engineer extending the existing R2.1 boundary without claiming full TERMINUS ABSOLUTE or changing the live WING installation
done:
Adds a signer abstraction where unavailable signing key causes REFUSE_POLICY_INVALID before broker call
Uses Ed25519 signatures over a canonical secret-free receipt payload containing envelope digest, decision, phase, policy/coverage, intended destination, provider/residency, keyed finding correlation, previous receipt digest, monotonic sequence, and key identifier
Persists an append-only test ledger and verifier with sequence/previous-digest/signature validation
Writes and verifies an external-anchor fixture for the chain head; a whole-ledger replacement fails anchor verification
Integrates receipt creation with the R2.1 real selected chat path and its fake client controls
Proves one-byte receipt mutation fails verification, signer failure makes zero provider calls, whole-ledger rewrite fails anchor verification, and planted secret remains absent from receipt/state/log output
Uses an isolated test-only key provider and fixture anchor; no Keychain, Secure Enclave, live provider, credentials, or network
Keeps all R1/R2.1 tests green and writes BUILD_HANDOFF.md with exact evidence/non-claims
non_goals:
Using or creating a real Keychain/Secure Enclave signing key
Mutating ~/.omnis-wing/omnis-wing, live WING profiles, or Videl configuration
Claiming legacy rows are signed, retro-signing history, or saying the whole ledger is globally signed
Covering streaming, other provider paths, all modalities, full source-taint propagation, whole-tree egress, packaging, publishing, or full ABSOLUTE certification
constraints:
Work only in ~/projects/omnis-wing on top of the approved R2.1 head
No receipt, exception, log, filename, or anchor may contain matched payload cleartext or bare SHA-256 of low-entropy markers
Missing signer/verification/anchor is a refusal or visibly invalid evidence state, never silent unsigned success
Use a keyed finding correlation construction, not f-0001 placeholder IDs, in newly signed receipts
Gate all tests cold/offline; builder does not self-certify
If an Ed25519 implementation cannot be used from existing declared dependencies without network/install, stop REFUSED_AS_UNSAFE and report the exact dependency constraint
format: A narrow OMNIS WING R3 evidence-spine commit with test-only key provider, receipt/ledger/anchor modules, R2.1 integration fixture, cold tests, coverage-manifest update, and BUILD_HANDOFF.md. Every artifact binds to this authority SHA-256 and names remaining non-claims.
